items.item: (1) The one page's ethics paragraph and how-far clause to the first screen's anchor (H13-H16), both languages
items.how: English: the in-time sentence after the condition ('Read in time, it holds only from some step on, and there exactly where each one's acts, from every step, come to bear on every other's later continuation', linked to 07 §4.11); widening in the screen's own words ('A course *widens* another when it keeps all the other keeps and lets more form, more future; where the condition holds, read across all steps, whatever a widening adds lies within the life's own reach'), so that the ranking is said on the condition read across all steps, which is what `Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_unrestricted` and `Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn` take (no theorem composes the from-some-step-on form with self-concern; ch08's left item); self-concern defined by H14's sentence; 'seeing them is needed for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough' (H13). How far: 'and read in time, from some step on, it holds exactly where the flow is mutually dependent in time; under the condition read across all steps, a self-concerned order ranks every widening above on a finite listing, and between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, so that their admissions end; the course of a line that persists without end never fits such a list (07 §4.9, `Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted`), so there this route is silent; mutual dependence and that ranking compose directly' (no 'one way' for the path result, H15). Chinese: the same, in the Chinese screen's words wherever the page says the same thing (有一种次序，这里称为*自我关切*…；自身的延续，这里读作自身所能到达的范围之内者; 扩大，就是更多的未来; 再把一个进程所容纳之物的权重加起来的计法，都把扩大了另一个的那个进程排得更高; 要让选择因它们的损失而改变，就得看见它们，但看见还不够; the how-far's 谱系 sentence, 只证明了这一个方向 and 模型对持续存在所显示的，只是对已作选择的一道筛选，并没有形成一种次序), except '在延续条件（跨越所有步来读）之下' where the screen says only 在延续条件之下. astra's one-page Chinese items: 5 凡是延续依存于他们的捕捞所改变之物的; 6 便及于自己行为下游的一切; 7 生命的延续也包含摄食与终结; 9 自我关切的次序把每一个扩大了另一个的进程，都排在被它扩大的进程之上, the finite listing in the same sentence. The ethics stays one paragraph in each language: the shorter route and its pins count the paragraph that opens with the lead.

items.item: (3) THE-THEORY §7: H18's sentence and the ethics sentences by H12-H16
items.how: H18, by astra's finding 2: 'With its own continuation read as what lies within its closure, self-concern asks only that a course be ranked above another where it widens the other on the listing and adds an item so marked; it gives no verdict where keeping one thing closes another, and it shows no reason formed. Whether a loss within the closure comes back to the center through an actual dependence, at a time and size that matter, and whether that becomes a reason of its own, take further relations [AI reading].' (IncreasingInOwn, Weightings.lean:6020; 07 §3's own reading of feeders at line 199 is conditional and stays there.) 'Read on relations': the full H16 form with `Flow.not_unrestricted_inTime`, `Flow.unrestrictedEventually_iff_mutuallyDependentInTime`, `Flow.unrestrictedAfter_iff_coupledEachStep`, `Drawing.lapses`, and 'Where the condition holds, on an acyclic relation every standpoint has the same center (`«续无外则同一中心»`); on a net going forward in time this comes from …(`«续无外当且仅当后与独»`, `«独则同一中心»`), and over what comes after two centers can meet it (`TwoSources.apart`)'. '"Emerges" names …' kept, its shown part at the path result's reach; the widening bullet gains H15's fixed-listing quantifier (`Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_iff_marks`), loses 'one way' (twice), and states the bound (`Web.admits_nothing_from_of_listed`, `Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted`, 'so there this route is silent'); C defined with `living` (H12), the short gloss said with every claim counted as living; 'Seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough'; 'Seeing more is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough' (07's 'does not show'); `increasingInOwn_of_increasing` sentence kept. Both tables' rows (condition: short H16 form plus the one-center bound and TwoSources; order: self-concern defined, path result with decided admission, its bound) and T8's row (H13), and §10's open item. H20's phrase does not occur in these pages.
